name: icon-morph-beat
title: Icon Morph Beat
description: Icon morph beat for vertical reels: one icon on a brand card holds its before state, morphs into its after state (mic, play or lock to check or unlock) while turning brand red, then marks completion with a small pulse and halo. The icon pair is a field. Brand palette, sized for the 780 px graphics field.

variables.label: Icon pair
variables.description: Before and after icon states used by the morph.
